title: Traversing Arrays
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of traversing arrays and identify when it is appropriate in a Java program.
Apply at least one of the lesson topics—indexed loops—in a small, readable example.
Predict the example result and check it against the stated output or a boundary-case test.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study traversing arrays with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you organize indexed data and avoid incorrect indexes or accidental sharing when copying arrays. In this lesson, focus on indexed loops and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
